scenarios.task: Confirm pixel dimensions, layers where relevant, colour/profile expectations and visual appearance after reopening. PSD/interchange need not retain every native feature. A successful tool call is not a durable save.

Check artboard count, coordinates, paths, fonts and import/export warnings. Reopen SVG/PDF/native output as appropriate and inspect the rendered result. Synchronous native operations may not support active cancellation.

Check duration, frame rate, timeline, audio and all media references. An export can leave a file while reporting failure because offline placeholders were rendered. Neither file existence nor a retry resolves that warning.

Verify RAW/develop expectations, rendered pixels, output filename and image properties. Exports may choose a new name on collision; repeated calls are not idempotent. No denoise service or live connect is started by this plugin.

Reopen the saved PDF and check page count, text and rendering. For redactions, use a genuine content-removal audit and inspect sanitized output; visual rectangles are not enough. The helper only checks PDF markers, not validity or confidentiality.

Check composition dimensions, timing, layer offset/stretch, expected frames and media. Preserve native warnings. Native batch rollback semantics are engine-specific; they do not promise cross-file or cross-app atomicity. Autosave is not enabled implicitly.

Inspect overset text, fonts, linked images, pages and exported layout. Validate the actual saved/exported file and render relevant pages. CLI export options may apply only to following exports; do not use shell fallback without an explicit unique need.

Save XLSX where supported, reopen, compare formulas and recalculated/typed values, and surface error cells. A structurally valid OOXML ZIP is not a formula/fidelity pass. Keep exported data provenance for downstream slide/document work.

Reopen DOCX and review text, tracked changes, fonts, pagination and exported PDF appearance. Legacy DOC may be read-only. Formats supported for reading are not automatically writable or semantically equivalent.
Reopen PPTX/native output, check slide count/content and render every slide. Review text overflow, charts, fonts, notes/handouts and warnings. A ZIP/XML check does not establish PowerPoint fidelity.

Compare known geometry, dimensions, entity counts and model-space units after reopening. View/window framing affects rendered outputs, not necessarily saved geometry. SVG/PNG/PDF export may leave the editable drawing unsaved.

Check missing media before bouncing. Verify actual audio duration, sample rate, channels and expected mix; listen when the task requires audio-quality judgment. Save the editable session separately. PCM parsing alone is not a mix or loudness approval.
